verdict.rationale: Meilisearch documents tenant tokens: short-lived, scoped API credentials generated from an API key that embed search rules/filters, explicitly compared to Algolia secured API keys and PostgreSQL row-level security — a clear least-privilege credentialing mechanism suitable for issuing to agents. Combined with the MCP server integration for AI agents, this directly supports scoped credential issuance for agent use. Missing for 10: no hands-on/independent verification of tenant token scoping specifically in an agent context, and no explicit documentation tying tenant tokens directly to MCP agent workflows.
